summary: Silverfort Core: identity protection built into the sign-in process without agents, with MFA for any system and discovery of weak spots in Active Directory.
value: MFA appears even where it could not be enabled before: legacy systems, command line, RDP.
Hidden administrators, abandoned accounts and weak AD settings are found.
No agents and no changes to applications.
simple: Account protection built right into the sign-in process (Active Directory, cloud directories, other authentication systems) — without agents or changes to applications, in on-premises, cloud and hybrid environments. Builds a single inventory and graph of all accounts — human and machine — and their permissions. Finds weak spots: hidden administrators, outdated and abandoned accounts, insecure settings, outdated protocols (ISPM). Extends multi-factor authentication (MFA) to things that usually don’t support it: legacy and custom applications, the command line, OT equipment, local Windows sign-ins. The set of modules may differ for on-premises, cloud or hybrid environments.
notIncluded: Service account protection (NHI) starts with Plus; ITDR with Advanced; just-in-time access in Enterprise.
classification: The ISPM and NHI classes were created for Silverfort; Identity Graph & Inventory is not CAASM and stays in the text.
